{"metadata":{"description":"Give your DSH agent hands: drive a real browser (Edge/Chrome over CDP) from the chat — ref-driven clicking, per-session browsers, and a live cockpit panel. Zero runtime deps, no API key.","id":"gh:1334990030","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-pilot","slug":"guo6x/dsh-pilot","topics":["agent","browser-automation","cdp","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Give your DSH agent hands: drive a real browser (Edge/Chrome over CDP) from the chat — ref-driven cl"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"icking, per-session browsers, and a live cockpit panel. Zero runtime deps, no API key."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🛩️ dsh-pilot — give your DSH agent hands"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) [](https://github.com/zp-home/dsh-recommend) [](https://github.co"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"m/zp-home/dsh-recommend) [](https://github.com/guo6x/dsh-pilot/actions/workflows/ci.yml) 中文说明 · Deep"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"mend) [](https://github.com/guo6x/dsh-pilot/actions/workflows/ci.yml) 中文说明 · DeepSeek Harness plugin"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Drive a **real browser** from the DeepSeek Harness chat: the agent opens pages, reads them as struct"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ured text with a **numbered element list**, clicks and types **by ref** (no CSS guessing), presses k"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"eys, navigates back/reload, waits, evaluates JS, and takes screenshots — while you watch a live drag"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"gable **cockpit panel** in the Web GUI and can take over at any time."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- 🚀 **One command install** — `dsh plugin --profile web add github:guo6x/dsh-pilot`
- ⚡ **Zero runti"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"me dependencies** — talks CDP over the native Node ≥ 22 WebSocket, uses the Edge/Chrome already on y"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"our machine
- 🔑 **No API key** — nothing leaves your machine; no vision model required
- 📖 **Text-fi"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"rst by design** — the agent reads DOM snapshots (title/URL/text/links + numbered elements), so **tex"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"t-only models** browse without burning vision tokens
- 🎯 **Ref-driven interaction** — every click/ty"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"pe targets a snapshot ref, not a guessed selector; stale refs fail loudly with a hint
- 📝 **Human-na"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"med forms** — fill several fields by label, aria-label, placeholder, name, or id, and upload files b"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"y ref
- 🧭 **Full navigation set** — back, reload, and wait tools for real browsing flows, with page-"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"settling waits built in
- 👀 **Human in the loop** — live screenshot, URL bar, action log, and a sess"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"ion switcher in the cockpit; you see everything the agent does
- 🧩 **Per-session isolation** — every"},{"id":"p5s11","text":" agent session gets its own browser instance; parallel sessions never fight over one page"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Watch it work"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Open the ✈️ cockpit, start its isolated browser, and watch the page change live. When several agents"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" are browsing, the demo also pins one session, then returns to automatic following."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why it feels different"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| What usually goes wrong | What dsh-pilot does instead |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Agents guess CSS selectors that silently hit the wrong element | Returns a numbered, visible-eleme"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"nt snapshot; actions use those refs and stale refs fail loudly |
| Form tasks take many fragile one-"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"field calls | `pilot_fill` resolves human-facing labels and fills text fields, textareas, and select"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"s in one action |
| Browser automation disappears into a black box | Shows a live cockpit with the c"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"urrent page, URL, status, and recent actions |
| Adding browser control pulls in a browser framework"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" and a cloud account | Uses Node 22’s native WebSocket plus the Edge/Chrome already on your machine "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"— no runtime dependency or API key |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What the agent gets"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `pilot_open` | Open a URL (launches the browser on first use), return title/URL/text snapshot |
| "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"`pilot_snapshot` | Read the current page as text: title, URL, visible text (8k chars), links, a **nu"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"mbered element list** (refs), and a **change summary** vs the previous snapshot |
| `pilot_diff` | R"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"eport ONLY what changed since the last snapshot (URL/title/text delta, elements added/removed) — jud"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ge whether an action worked without re-reading the page |
| `pilot_click` | Click an element **by it"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"s snapshot ref** (or CSS selector); scrolls into view first |
| `pilot_type` | Type into an input **"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"by its snapshot ref** (or selector) via the native value setter — React/Vue forms observe it |
| `pi"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"lot_fill` | Fill text inputs, textareas, and selects in one call by label/aria-label/placeholder/nam"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"e/id |
| `pilot_upload` | Upload 1–10 absolute-path files to a file input **by its snapshot ref** (o"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"r selector); 100 MB total cap |
| `pilot_press` | Press a key (Enter/Tab/Escape/arrows/single chars)"},{"id":"p13s11","text":" |
| `pilot_back` | Go back in history, waits for the page to settle, returns URL/title |
| `pilot_r"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"eload` | Reload the current page, waits for it to settle |
| `pilot_wait` | Wait N ms (1–30000) for "},{"id":"p13s13","text":"async content before the next action |
| `pilot_wait_for` | Wait until page text, a visible element,"},{"id":"p13s14","text":" or a URL condition is met instead of sleeping blindly |
| `pilot_assert` | Immediately verify page "},{"id":"p13s15","text":"text, a visible element, or a URL condition |
| `pilot_screenshot` | Save a PNG and return its path "},{"id":"p13s16","text":"(for vision-capable models or the human) |
| `pilot_download` | Download a resource (default: curren"},{"id":"p13s17","text":"t page) through the page's own fetch — inherits session cookies; cap 20 MB |
| `pilot_eval` | Evalua"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"te JS in the page, get JSON back |
| `pilot_close` | Stop the browser; the next call relaunches it |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The agent just says what it needs: *"open the login page, fill the form, click submit, and read the "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"result"* — the tools are the same verbs."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## What the human gets"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"A draggable cockpit overlay: live screenshot (2 s refresh), current URL + title, start/stop buttons,"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" an address bar, and the recent action log. When several sessions are browsing, choose one to inspec"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"t or leave it on **Latest activity** to follow the agent automatically. Everything the agent does is"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" visible; close the browser or take over whenever you like."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **One tab per session.** Refs are pinned to the current page, so a tab switcher would invalidate t"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"hem. Need a second context? Spawn a subagent — each agent session gets its own browser.
- **Headless"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" only.** The cockpit shows the headless view; there is no headed mode (a human driving the same brow"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ser is a different product).
- **The panel follows the most recently used session by default.** When"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" several sessions exist, you can pin the cockpit to any one of them; switch back to **Latest activit"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"y** to resume automatic following."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Browser runs **headless with an isolated profile**; it never touches your real browser session.
- "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"The HTTP API binds to the DSH server (loopback by default) and rejects non-loopback clients explicit"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ly.
- `pilot_open` accepts http(s) URLs only; `pilot_eval` runs page-context JS (same trust as openi"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ng DevTools yourself — do not point the agent at pages you don't trust).
- `pilot_upload` accepts ex"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"isting absolute regular files only; upload only files the user has authorized for the current site.
"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"- No telemetry, no network calls to third parties, no API keys."}],"truncated":true}
